name: LocateFamily
instructions: Open https://www.locatefamily.com/removal2.html and follow the site's steps for {full_name}. Use {contact_email} wherever it asks for an email address, so the reply is matched. Then press "I've done this".
notes: The form asks for the listing page's address and the entry number shown at the left of each name, so a person finds the page first. One form per page.
source: Opt-out page listed in The Opt-Out Manual 2026 (thumpersecure/opt-out-manual-2026, public domain). On 2026-10-11 OpenOptOut loaded the page (no details entered) and it was an opt-out form.
